```artifact
Feature: Alarms in the GUI and Controller

  Scenario: GUI alarm for blocked input air line
    Given the input air line is blocked
    When the system detects the low pressure
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Input air line blocked"

  Scenario: GUI alarm for blocked input O2 line
    Given the input O2 line is blocked
    When the system detects the low pressure
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Input O2 line blocked"

  Scenario: GUI alarm for inspiratory pressure too low
    Given the inspiratory pressure drops below -4cm H2O
    When the system detects the low pressure
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Inspiratory pressure too low"

  Scenario: GUI alarm for high input O2 line pressure
    Given the input O2 line pressure is too high
    When the system detects the high pressure
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Input O2 line pressure too high"

  Scenario: GUI alarm for GUI unresponsiveness
    Given the GUI is unresponsive for 1/2 of the apnea time
    When the system detects the unresponsiveness
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "GUI unresponsive"

  Scenario: GUI alarm for controller unresponsiveness
    Given the controller is unresponsive for 1/2 of the apnea time
    When the system detects the unresponsiveness
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Controller unresponsive"

  Scenario: Controller alarm for overpressure
    Given the pressure exceeds 60 cmH2O
    When the system detects the overpressure
    Then the controller must trigger an alarm
    And the alarm message must be "Overpressure"

  Scenario Outline: GUI alarm for normal conditions
    Given the system is in normal conditions
    When the system detects normal conditions
    Then the GUI must not display any alarms
    Examples:
      | Input air line | Input O2 line | Inspiratory pressure | Input O2 line pressure | GUI responsiveness | Controller responsiveness |
      |----------------|---------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------------------|-------------------------|
      | Normal         | Normal        | Normal               | Normal                 | Responsive         | Responsive              |
      | Normal         | Normal        | Normal               | Normal                 | Responsive         | Unresponsive            |
      | Normal         | Normal        | Normal               | Normal                 | Unresponsive         | Responsive              |
      | Normal         | Normal        | Normal               | Normal                 | Unresponsive         | Unresponsive            |

  Scenario Outline: GUI alarm for edge conditions
    Given the system is in edge conditions
    When the system detects edge conditions
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    Examples:
      | Input air line | Input O2 line | Inspiratory pressure | Input O2 line pressure | GUI responsiveness | Controller responsiveness |
      |----------------|---------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------------------|-------------------------|
      | Blocked        | Normal        | -4.00                | Normal                 | Responsive         | Responsive              |
      | Normal         | Blocked       | Normal               | Normal                 | Responsive         | Responsive              |
      | Normal         | Normal        | -4.01                | Normal                 | Responsive         | Responsive              |
      | Normal         | Normal        | Normal               | 60.00                  | Responsive         | Responsive              |
      | Normal         | Normal        | Normal               | 60.01                  | Responsive         | Responsive              |
      | Normal         | Normal        | Normal               | Normal                 | Unresponsive         | Responsive              |
      | Normal         | Normal        | Normal               | Normal                 | Responsive         | Unresponsive            |
      | Normal         | Normal        | Normal               | Normal                 | Unresponsive         | Unresponsive            |
```
